item.title: A-List: FIFA's top-4 make WC semis for first time
item.description:
The Unprecedented Quartet

The world’s top football nations are poised to etch their names in history as Argentina, Spain, France, and England made it past the quarterfinals of the World Cup, a feat no top-four ranked teams have ever achieved in the competition’s history. Argentina, the reigning champions, have been in scintillating form, with their impressive 3-0 win against Australia setting them up for a mouth-watering clash against the Netherlands in the semis. For France, the defending runners-up, a 2-1 victory over Poland secured their spot alongside England, who edged out Senegal 3-0 in the last eight. Meanwhile, Spain, who have been struggling for consistency throughout the tournament, edged out Croatia 3-1 in a high-intensity match.
